6.283 rsInvalidMeasurementUnit
Applies to RDL 2003/10, RDL 2005/01, and RDL 2008/01
rsInvalidMeasurementUnit is a critical error that will occur when an element that requires an RdlSize
value is set to a measurement in terms of "em", "ex", or "%".
